_comment: MacroTilt data element registry per project Data Steward standards. Every element on the live site has source, ingestion mode, owner, cadence, freshness SLA, and registered consumers. v2 (2026-05-12) is the first pass that backfills the registry from 8 entries (v1) to all 75 feeds catalogued in DATA_LINEAGE_2026-05-12.md. Feeds with cadence='unknown — needs verification' are flagged in the _open_questions block below. v3 (2026-05-15) adds the MacroTilt 2-axis engine snapshot as a derived indicator element. Engine validated 1986-2026 (locked 2026-05-13). v4 (2026-05-20) registers the two Phase 1 data feeds for the rebuilt Trading Opportunities screener: scanner.darkpool-prints-uw and scanner.options-eod-uw. v6 (2026-05-21) records the Trading Opportunities dark-pool and options scoring engines going live (darkpool_scoring.py / options_scoring.py): both feeds move from “engine not yet built” to a live consumer; the screener score ceiling rises 5 -> 10. v5 (2026-05-21) records the Macro Overview data-quality correction pass: IG OAS re-pointed from the BAA-minus-DGS10 proxy to the canonical ICE BofA series (BAMLC0A0CM); IG OAS, the HY/IG ratio, and the commercial-paper spread moved off period-end resampling that was publishing future-dated stamps; the copper/gold ratio rescaled to the desk convention (x1000); and term-premium cadence corrected to daily. v7 (2026-05-22) registers news.market-headlines-multisource, the Home market-news headlines feed, after a SCAN_345PM idempotency-gate shell syntax error silently froze it at 2026-05-19. v8 (2026-05-22) moves that feed from the once-a-day scanner bake to an on-demand endpoint (api/macro-news.js), fetched on page load and CDN-cached ~10 min. v9 (2026-05-25) records the #1208 fix to the Trading Opportunities screener's prices_eod cold pull: the cross-run resume now paginates one ticker at a time (index-served range scans, no PostgREST or= disjunction that timed out) and mirrors the completed price panel to a durable Supabase Storage backstop (bucket screener-cache). v10 (2026-06-11) honest-stamp one-shot: +12 previously-untracked elements registered; stamp semantics fixed across all producers (last_good_at = real run time; data_as_of = business date, never future). v11 (2026-06-11) un-registered put_call/buffett/bank_unreal (killed 2026-06-10; mistakenly re-registered same day). v12 (2026-06-11 PM): normalized 37 daily market-series SLAs 73h->49h to the documented daily standard (the 73h padding predated honest close-anchored stamps + the 16:30 ET EOD chain and is no longer needed); corrected stale fetch times (scanner 15:30->03:30 overnight run; allocation ->08:15 per its workflow cron). v13 (2026-06-11 PM, Joe SLA doctrine): stale = >24h past due. Same-evening dailies 49h; T+1-publishing FRED dailies 73h (documented basis per element); COT 504h->192h. Monthly/quarterly extended budgets allowed only for documented publication lags — per-series calibration queued.
_freshness_sla_basis: One-clock (FRESHNESS_CHIP_SPEC 2026-06-16): freshness_sla_hours is the JOB's run cadence + grace, NOT the data's publication lag. The chip grades green/red off the LAST PULL (pipeline_health.last_good_at, the job's real last successful run) vs this SLA, calendar-aware so weekends/holidays never count. Daily job = 49h (~2 business days). Weekly job = 192h. Bi-monthly (FINRA) = 480h. Monthly job = 768h. Quarterly job = 2400h. A lagged data series (e.g. a monthly read by the daily job) stays GREEN while the daily job pulls — its weeks-old as_of no longer reds the chip.

indicator.composite-share-badge and indicator.license-tier-badge — these are hand-curated metadata reads (dataRegistry.js + this file), not separate feeds. Listed under infra for completeness.

Runs the backtest-calibrated engine (insider + trend layers, with the 15-day-plateau insider age-decay) over the eligible universe and appends one dated snapshot per launched name. Append-only: earlier scan_dates are never overwritten. The screener's prices_eod cold pull paginates one ticker at a time (index-served range scans) and caches the completed price panel to GitHub Actions cache plus a durable Supabase Storage backstop (bucket screener-cache, object trading_opps/prices.pkl) so a cache eviction cannot reproduce a cold-pull outage; steady-state nightly runs do a seconds-long incremental refresh of the latest trade day (#1208).

market.portfolio-risk-proxies-daily.element: Trailing-risk proxy returns (~3y daily) for the Portfolio risk-metrics card
consumer_surfaces: Portfolio Insights -> Risk metrics (trailing) card -> volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown, value-at-risk, factor betas
Portfolio Insights -> 'Proxy-based estimate - as of {date}' stamp
market.portfolio-risk-proxies-daily.failure_mode: Risk-metrics card shows 'Computing...' and the as-of stamp goes stale; portfolio-level stats are computed client-side so last-good feed keeps working.
market.portfolio-risk-proxies-daily.notes: Funds without clean daily history map to liquid proxies (JHYUX->HYG, NHXINT906->EFA, FXAIX->SPY, FSKAX->VTI, FBTC->BTC-USD, ETHE->ETH-USD; GLD/SLV/PLSE/RCAT/QQQ themselves; IEF=rates factor, SPY=market factor). Portfolio-level vol/Sharpe/Sortino/maxDD/VaR/betas computed client-side from these series + live weights. Risk-free = 13-week T-bill (^IRX). Validated against a Python backtest (vol 6.5%, Sharpe 1.25, beta-to-HY 0.94) 2026-05-31.
